Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG interface sprite atlas for Duelo do Futuro EEJAM, refined 3D cartoon school party game.
Create EXACTLY 36 isolated icon images in a strict regular SIX COLUMN by SIX ROW grid. Equal square cells and equal icon scale, 20% transparent gutters in every cell, generous safe outer padding. Bold rounded modeled volumes, deep navy contours, polished blue/orange/gold/purple/green toy materials, high contrast on dark game screens. Each icon self contained, no square colored backdrop unless it is the physical object itself.
Exact order:
ROW1: pause bars; circular restart arrow; speaker with sound waves; muted speaker with small X; fullscreen outward corners; left back arrow.
ROW2: gear; padlock; green confirmation tick; red cancellation cross; crossed shuffle arrows; backup storage/cloud with upward arrow.
ROW3: trash bin; pencil; stopwatch; single gentle touch hand; hand dragging with horizontal arrows; musical note.
ROW4: blue/orange VS emblem (only exact text "VS"); golden trophy; gold star; idea lightbulb; open blue book; blue/orange rocket.
ROW5: information symbol on blue circular badge; solo player silhouette badge; three-team silhouettes badge blue/orange/purple; ranking podium; RED/PINK PENNANT FLAG with a little gold pole; green check spark.
ROW6: red error cross spark; right next arrow; orange warning triangle; home/school silhouette; play triangle; magnifying glass.
No labels, no headings, no text except VS and the single information i symbol. True transparent alpha outside the 36 silhouettes. No environment, no backgrounds, no watermarks. Flat front-on readable symbols with subtle 3D depth, matching game selection badges.

Software will cut this image into real interlocking pieces.

A few school-supply props add identity but no people or faces.
Every area has connected recognizable shapes, different color details and texture, avoid large empty uniform sky. Crisp rounded forms, refined 3D cartoon illustration, warm daylight, blue/orange/yellow/green/purple school-game palette. Clear silhouette edges and coherent perspective, medium detail, vibrant inviting, appropriate for ages14–15.
Full bleed rectangular source picture, opaque background, no transparency; image will become the complete target image for the game.
